meta.title: Bill Formatter — XML Ingestion to Invoice Distribution

lanes.name: Billing Operations User
lanes.hint: Admin Console / Bill Formatter Portal actions

lanes.name: Bill Formatter (DXP)
lanes.hint: Core ingestion, generation, masking, reporting engine

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Hot bill landing, notification logging, resend/reprint requests

nodes.label: Bill Run / Manual Upload Trigger
nodes.desc: Invoice XML retrieval begins from the Mediation Zone predefined input location for regular, trial and hot bills, or an authorised user performs a manual XML/ZIP upload.

nodes.label: Atomic File Write
nodes.desc: The XML file is written to a temporary location or filename, closed and verified, then renamed/moved to the final destination so no partially written file is readable downstream.

nodes.label: Batch Grouping
nodes.desc: XML files are retrieved and processed batch-wise; each collection cycle produces a single batch identifier.

nodes.label: Duplicate Prevention Check
nodes.desc: The same invoice XML file is not processed more than once.

nodes.label: Log Retrieval Status
nodes.desc: Retrieval and load status is logged for every XML file.

nodes.label: Retrieval Successful?
nodes.desc: Retrieval errors are retried per the configured retry policy; a persistent failure is raised for operational review.

nodes.label: Persistent Retrieval Failure Raised
nodes.desc: A persistent retrieval failure is raised for operational review after configured retries are exhausted.

nodes.label: Derive Invoice Type & Segment
nodes.desc: Invoice type and customer segment are derived from the loaded XML content.

nodes.label: Schema & Mandatory Data Validation
nodes.desc: XML is validated for schema conformance and mandatory billing data. Only files passing both proceed to invoice generation.

nodes.label: XML Valid?
nodes.desc: A validation failure marks the file as Failed XML with a recorded reason.

nodes.label: Failed XML — Reason Recorded
nodes.sub: BR-009, BR-010, XML Record: Failed XML
nodes.desc: The XML is marked Failed XML with the failure reason recorded and is visible in the portal for review and reprocessing after corrective action.

nodes.label: Review & Reprocess Failed XML
nodes.desc: Billing Operations reviews failed XML records in the portal and initiates reprocessing following corrective action.

nodes.label: Update Batch Statistics
nodes.desc: Batch statistics are updated to reflect successful and failed XML processing outcomes.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Presence Check
nodes.desc: A scheduler checks every ten minutes for an expected supporting CSV; if still absent four hours after XML receipt, an alert email is issued to configured recipients.

nodes.label: Supporting CSV Missing Alert
nodes.desc: An alert email is issued to the configured recipients when the expected supporting CSV remains absent four hours after XML receipt.

nodes.label: Parse XML & Load Data
nodes.desc: Invoice Header, Invoice Summary and Invoice Detail structures are loaded from the parsed XML.

nodes.label: Generate Invoice Output
nodes.desc: PDF, XLS and CSV invoice outputs are generated for regular, trial and hot bills across Consumer Mobile, Consumer Fixed Line, Enterprise, Black, Bulk SMS and IoT segments in English and Arabic.

nodes.label: Generation Successful?
nodes.desc: Invoices failing processing or generation carry a recorded failure status and reason, visible in the portal.

nodes.label: Invoice Failed — Reason Recorded
nodes.desc: Invoice generation failure carries a recorded failure status and reason, visible in the portal.

nodes.label: Reprocessing Control (Role-based)
nodes.desc: Reprocessing of a failed invoice or batch is restricted by role and the retry count is recorded.

nodes.label: Invoice Completed
nodes.desc: All invoice outputs within the batch have been generated.

nodes.label: Initiate Invoice Regeneration
nodes.desc: Billing Operations initiates an invoice regeneration request at individual invoice or batch level through the Bill Formatter application.

nodes.label: Source XML Corrected?
nodes.desc: Where the source XML has been regenerated or corrected, regeneration consumes the latest version.

nodes.label: Legacy Invoice Buffer Lookup
nodes.desc: Invoices are regenerable from the legacy XML data held in the Invoice Buffer table, including invoices generated several years previously.

nodes.label: Regenerate Invoice (Retry + Status)
nodes.desc: Invoice regeneration is supported at both individual invoice level and batch level, and includes retry and status reporting.

nodes.label: Review & Approval Switch On?
nodes.desc: Invoice review and approval before customer dispatch follows role-based access and is controlled by a switch defaulted to off.

nodes.label: Reviewer Approve/Reject
nodes.desc: Invoice reviewed and approved for despatch, or reviewed and rejected with despatch prevented and the invoice returned to Pending on regeneration.

nodes.label: Invoice Rejected
nodes.desc: Invoice reviewed and rejected; despatch is prevented and the invoice returns to Pending on regeneration.

nodes.label: Make Invoice Available to Channels
nodes.desc: Generated invoices are made available to downstream channels through the configured integration flow, with regular bill copies provided to Siebel CRM and other customer channels.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Landing Location
nodes.desc: Hot bill invoices are placed in the Siebel CRM hot bill landing location and are available in real time following generation.

nodes.label: Exclude Trial Batches from Channel Upload
nodes.desc: Trial batches are excluded from channel upload.

nodes.label: Apply Pre-Despatch Masking
nodes.desc: Customer specific masking rules are applied to the invoice before despatch through any communication channel.

nodes.label: Eligible for Email?
nodes.desc: Only successfully generated invoices are eligible for email distribution; trial invoices are never emailed.

nodes.label: Despatch Suppressed
nodes.desc: A configurable list of non-triable email addresses is maintained; despatch is not attempted for a match on the suppression list.

nodes.label: Determine Email Template
nodes.desc: The email template is determined by customer type, invoice type and language; separate templates are supported for Consumer and Enterprise in English and Arabic, with configurable dynamic fields.

nodes.label: SMTP Despatch
nodes.desc: Email is despatched through the configured SMTP service, which captures delivery feedback and provides success and failure reporting.

nodes.label: Delivered?
nodes.desc: SMTP acceptance moves the email to Sent; delivery feedback confirms Delivered or reports Failed, which is retried and resent.

nodes.label: Email Delivery Failed
nodes.sub: Email: Failed, Invoice: Failed Sending Email
nodes.desc: Delivery failed and the failure is reported in the Failed Email Report; the email is resent on retry.

nodes.label: Create CRM Notification Record
nodes.desc: A CRM notification record is created only for invoices processed for customer communication and is stored against the customer account and bill reference for servicing and audit.

nodes.label: SMS / WhatsApp / Web Delivery
nodes.desc: Invoice communication is also supported through SMS, WhatsApp Business and Web, carrying a PDF reference or an invoice URL.

nodes.label: Search Invoices & Reports
nodes.desc: Invoice and report search supports invoice type, invoice number, batch identifier, date created, language, MSISDN, product, status, email address, account number, customer type and Bill Formatter internal identifier.

nodes.label: Search Result Actions
nodes.desc: Search results support download, regenerate, reprocess and email actions, with availability determined by user role and invoice status; download formats are PDF, XML, XLS and CSV.

nodes.label: Configuration Drill-Down
nodes.desc: Configuration records open in a separate window or pop-up view, and selecting a batch identifier displays the invoices belonging to that batch.

nodes.label: Admin Console — Batch/Bill Status
nodes.desc: The Admin Console displays batch identifier, date created, reference, status, number of documents and the ZIP document, with status maintained at both batch and bill level across the operational status values.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Register
nodes.desc: The hot bill register displays identifier, process date, bill number, status, email address, total size, current month due, total due and the action menu.

nodes.label: Template & Presentation Configuration
nodes.desc: Bill template field maintenance by segment and invoice type, email and resend template configuration, bill banner configuration and overlap resolution, report template configuration and interactive PDF features.

nodes.label: Bill Run Monitor Alert
nodes.desc: The Bill Run Monitor email report is despatched during bill run windows at the configured interval from first batch start until the last batch or end marker.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Failure Alert
nodes.desc: Failed hot bill generation is identified and an email alert report is despatched at the configured interval.

nodes.label: Generate Masked Invoice File
nodes.desc: A separate masked invoice file is generated at the point of invoice generation for each applicable invoice; Tax Identifier, Payment Method and Phone Number are masked in accordance with the configured access policy.

nodes.label: Original Invoice Remains Immutable
nodes.desc: The original customer invoice is generated, stored and remains unchanged and immutable.

nodes.label: Privileged Role?
nodes.desc: The user role and access permission determine whether the full invoice or the masked invoice is presented; privileged roles view the full invoice and restricted roles view the masked version.

nodes.label: Present Masked Invoice
nodes.desc: Restricted roles view the masked invoice version.

nodes.label: Present Full Invoice
nodes.desc: Privileged roles view the full invoice.

nodes.label: Agent Copy / Customer Copy Download
nodes.desc: The bill download offers an Agent Copy and a Customer Copy; the Agent Copy is produced either as a summarised format without the usage view or as a masked format, each enabled or disabled by configuration.

nodes.label: Masking Rule Configuration
nodes.desc: Masking rules are configurable without requiring invoice regeneration for rules applied at the point of presentation.

nodes.label: Invoice Presented per Access Policy
nodes.desc: The correct invoice presentation (full or masked) has been delivered to the requesting user per role-based access policy.

nodes.label: Reprint Request from Siebel CRM
nodes.desc: A reprint request carries the account number, bill period and bill type and originates from Siebel CRM.

nodes.label: Retrieve XML & Regenerate PDF
nodes.desc: Reprint does not alter the original invoice data; only a previously generated bill may be reprinted, with Detailed or Summarised bill type and English or Arabic language selection.

nodes.label: Transfer PDF via Mediation Zone
nodes.desc: The reprinted PDF is transferred through the Mediation Zone to the requesting channel.

nodes.label: Reprint/Resend Registers
nodes.desc: Reprint and resend requests are displayed in dedicated console registers with status and process date.

nodes.label: Resend Request from Siebel CRM
nodes.desc: A resend request carries the account number and bill reference; only a previously generated invoice may be resent.

nodes.label: Apply Resend Email Template
nodes.desc: The resend email template may differ from the first-time bill email template and is separately maintainable in English and Arabic.

nodes.label: Despatch Resend Email
nodes.desc: The resend invoice is despatched and the delivery status is recorded and visible.

nodes.label: Preserve Existing Interface Signatures
nodes.desc: The existing reprint and resend interface signatures remain unchanged to support parallel running and to avoid impact to current channels.

nodes.label: Batch/Bill Cycle Complete
nodes.desc: Invoice emails for the batch have been despatched, completing the batch processing lifecycle.

nodes.label: Pull XML — Regular Bill
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from the Mediation Zone for regular bills at the predefined file location, with retry on error.

nodes.label: Pull XML — Trial Bill
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from BRM/Billing source for trial bills, with retry on error.

nodes.label: Pull XML — Hot Bill
nodes.desc: Formatter pulls invoice XML from BRM/Billing source for hot bills, with retry on error.

nodes.label: Data Ingestion (XML or DB Table)
nodes.desc: Bill Formatter ingests invoice data either as XML or from a database table.

nodes.label: Search Uploaded Bill XML
nodes.desc: Billing Operations user searches uploaded bill XML records; results show the latest processing status.

nodes.label: XML Record Action Options
nodes.desc: Clicking Action on an XML record offers Operational Log, Download XML, and Regenerate XML.

nodes.label: View XML Operational Log
nodes.desc: Displays the operational log: Id, Type, Description, Data, Date Created.

nodes.label: Download XML
nodes.desc: Downloads the selected XML file.

nodes.label: Regenerate XML (from Search)
nodes.desc: Requests BRM to regenerate the XML for the selected record.

nodes.label: Batch Status Report
nodes.desc: Provides Billing Operations users real-time visibility of batch processing status, invoice generation status and XML status at the batch level (Failed/Ready/Report Generated/Invoice Completed/Email Sent/Failed Sending Email/Failed XML Data).

nodes.label: Create Batch / Upload Batch
nodes.desc: Authorised user creates a batch (automated BRM/MZ pickup) or uploads a batch manually.

nodes.label: Bill-Level Status Report
nodes.desc: Provides real-time status updates for individual bills processed within a batch, using the same status values.

nodes.label: Batch Action Menu — View Bill
nodes.desc: Batch Action menu exposes a 'View Bill' option showing the bill details of that batch.

nodes.label: View Bill — Action Sub-Menu
nodes.desc: Selecting View Bill on a batch opens its own Action sub-menu.

nodes.label: View Bill → Status Log
nodes.desc: Shows Id, Label, Reason, Date Created for the selected bill.

nodes.label: View Bill → Download PDF
nodes.desc: Downloads the selected bill's PDF.

nodes.label: View Bill → Download XLS
nodes.desc: Downloads the selected bill's XLS.

nodes.label: View Bill → Download XML
nodes.desc: Downloads the selected bill's XML.

nodes.label: View Bill → Reprint Bill
nodes.desc: Reprints the bill; prompts for bill type (Summary/Detailed) and language.

nodes.label: View Bill → Regenerate Document
nodes.desc: Initiates generation of the document for the selected bill.

nodes.label: View Bill → Regenerate XML
nodes.desc: Initiates creation of the XML for the selected bill.

nodes.label: View Bill → Send Email
nodes.desc: Sends the bill email per the configured template and address, excluding the non-triable list.

nodes.label: Batch → View Statistics
nodes.desc: Shows successful PDF generation counts graphically plus a failed-PDF list (Id, Bill No., Acct. No., Status, Reason).

nodes.label: Batch → Overall Report
nodes.desc: Downloads the Overall Report for the batch in XLS format.

nodes.label: Batch → Detailed Report
nodes.desc: Downloads the Detailed Report for the batch in XLS format.

nodes.label: Batch → Failed Report
nodes.desc: Downloads the Failed Report for the batch in XLS format.

nodes.label: Batch → Failed Emails Report
nodes.desc: Downloads the Failed Emails Report for the batch in XLS format.

nodes.label: Batch → Send Overall Report
nodes.desc: Generates the Overall Report in XLS format for distribution.

nodes.label: Batch → Send Email
nodes.desc: Sends an email to the batch's customers per the configured template.

nodes.label: Detailed Batch Report
nodes.desc: Detailed Batch Report with bill-level aggregation (plan/extras/payment/dues) and service-specific tabs.

nodes.label: Overall Batch Report
nodes.desc: Overall Batch Report summarising each generated bill/document; delivery preference (PDF only vs PDF+XLS) drives output; Document ID is unique per document.

nodes.label: Operational Stats — Email Delivery
nodes.desc: Reports total successful and failed emails per batch, account-wise and bill-wise, including exclusion-list and invalid/failure scenarios.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Generation Failed Report
nodes.desc: Runs every four hours; identifies failed hot bill generation and sends an email alert/report.

nodes.label: Review Generated Invoices (Switch-Controlled)
nodes.desc: Role-based users may review generated invoices/documents and approve or reject them before customer dispatch; gated by an on/off switch, default OFF.

nodes.label: Admin Console
nodes.desc: Front-end Admin Console for Billing Ops to manage batches, bills, hot bills, XMLs, reports, translations, settings and role-based access.

nodes.label: Centralised Configuration Drill-Down
nodes.desc: Selected configuration records open in a pop-up; selecting a Batch ID shows that batch's invoice details.

nodes.label: Translation Configuration
nodes.desc: Language column mandatory; translation list self-updates from XML fields; applied during invoice generation.

nodes.label: Translation — Edit / Show-Hide per Invoice Type
nodes.desc: Edit action per record; Show/Hide a product explicitly per invoice column (Consumer PDF, Enterprise PDF, Enterprise XLS).

nodes.label: Adjustment Reason Configuration
nodes.desc: Search and view configured adjustment reason codes and labels.

nodes.label: Adjustment Reason — Create
nodes.desc: Create a new adjustment reason code/label; only configured reasons display on the invoice.

nodes.label: Adjustment Reason — Edit
nodes.desc: Update or remove an existing adjustment reason code/label.

nodes.label: Benefits Configuration
nodes.desc: Displays plan benefits against a product on the invoice; product list auto-updates from BRM XML; syncs with product catalogue.

nodes.label: Benefits — Create
nodes.desc: Create a new benefit record.

nodes.label: Benefits — Search
nodes.desc: Search existing benefits by name.

nodes.label: Benefits — Edit / Delete
nodes.desc: Configure/edit benefit fields (Id, Name, Value, Product) or delete a benefit record.

nodes.label: Flex Bucket ID Configuration
nodes.desc: Maintain the Flex Bucket ID list per product; used to display Flex Bucket usage on the invoice; syncs with product catalogue.

nodes.label: Flex Bucket — Edit / Delete
nodes.desc: Action menu per record: edit or delete a Flex Bucket ID.

nodes.label: Flex Bucket — Create / Import / Export
nodes.desc: Create a new Flex record, bulk-import Flex records, or export configuration.

nodes.label: VAS Short Code Configuration
nodes.desc: Classifies usage CDRs under VAS Usage on the invoice; mapping maintained from Called_To/Record_Type in BRM XML; syncs with product catalogue.

nodes.label: VAS Short Code — Edit / Delete
nodes.desc: Action menu per record: edit or delete a VAS short code mapping.

nodes.label: VAS Short Code — Search
nodes.desc: Search existing VAS codes; results show Called_To, Record_Type and display/translation details.

nodes.label: Bill Email Template Configuration
nodes.desc: Separate first-time and resend templates for Consumer and Enterprise customers.

nodes.label: Email Template — Edit
nodes.desc: Action menu per record: edit subject/body/dynamic fields (Id, Name, Value, Product).

nodes.label: Bill Template Change
nodes.desc: Implements a cosmetically enhanced template supplied by the business, replicated in Bill Formatter.

nodes.label: Data Sorting on Page Headers
nodes.desc: Sorting options on page headers let users arrange records ascending or descending.

nodes.label: Bill Banner Configuration
nodes.desc: Search/view bill banners per language and customer type; overflow content continues on the next page, banner retained on both.

nodes.label: Configuration Export / Import
nodes.desc: Export/import configuration data in XLS/CSV formats; maintenance controlled by role.

nodes.label: Configuration Active-From / Active-To
nodes.desc: Configuration activation/deactivation controlled using Active From and Active To dates.

nodes.label: Billing Reports by Business Need
nodes.desc: Billing users generate reports and send to specified email IDs or distribution lists; supports enterprise-specific structures, frequency and formats.

nodes.label: Report Download / Export
nodes.desc: Reports can be downloaded/exported in PDF or Excel format.

nodes.label: Business Reports (Agreed Needs)
nodes.desc: Provides reports required by business users per agreed reporting needs.

nodes.label: Operational Statistics Dashboard
nodes.desc: Operational statistics for successful/failed invoices by batch, split Consumer vs Enterprise.

nodes.label: Operational Stats — Average Bill Size
nodes.desc: Average bill size statistics, segregated by Consumer and Enterprise.

nodes.label: Failed Email Report Export
nodes.desc: Exportable Failed Bills Report including Account Number, Bill Number, Bill Status, Status Reason.

nodes.label: XML Processing Statistics Report
nodes.desc: Statistics Report for XML processing activity (uploaded vs processed, monthly stats).

nodes.label: Large Enterprise Billing Reports
nodes.desc: Customer-specific format report generation for very large enterprise accounts.

nodes.label: Billing Reports Accounts Manager
nodes.desc: Configure the accounts, report type and template used for enterprise billing reports.

nodes.label: Overall & Detail Reports
nodes.desc: Overall and Detail Reports for a selected invoice batch in XLS format.

nodes.label: Report Template Configuration
nodes.desc: Configure, modify and delete report templates; used when sending reports to configured recipients.

nodes.label: Plan Speed Configuration
nodes.desc: Search, configure and update Plan Speed configurations; syncs with product catalogue.

nodes.label: Report Template — Bill Run Monitor
nodes.desc: Scheduled email reports during bill run windows (e.g. 2nd/16th), hourly or configured interval.

nodes.label: Report Template — VLB
nodes.desc: VLB report template configuration with Action/Sub-menu edit option.

nodes.label: Report Template — Overall
nodes.desc: Overall report template configuration with Action/Sub-menu edit option.

nodes.label: Report Template — Internal
nodes.desc: Internal report template configuration with Action/Sub-menu edit option.

nodes.label: Invoice Template Change Documentation
nodes.desc: All invoice field definitions, rules and business logic governing the template are exposed and maintained as documentation.

nodes.label: Calculated Invoice/Report Fields
nodes.desc: Fields not directly available from source systems are computed via defined calculation logic.

nodes.label: Invoice Template Business Rules
nodes.desc: All business rules currently defined within the invoice templates are implemented.

nodes.label: Reprint Console — List View
nodes.desc: Lists prior reprint requests: ID, Process Date, Bill Number, Status, Email, Total Size, This Month Due, Total Due.

nodes.label: Reprint Console — Action Menu
nodes.desc: Per-record Action menu: Status Log, Download PDF/XLS/XML, Reprint Bill, Regenerate Document/XML, Send Email.

nodes.label: Reprint → Status Log
nodes.desc: Shows Id, Label, Reason, Date Created for the selected batch/bill.

nodes.label: Reprint → Reprint Bill
nodes.desc: Prompts bill type (Summary/Detailed) and language, then regenerates.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Console — List View
nodes.desc: Displays Hot Bill details: Id, Process Date, Bill No, Status, Email, Total Size, This Month Due, Total Due.

nodes.label: Hot Bill Console — Action Menu
nodes.desc: Batch → Action → View Bills exposes the same 8-action sub-menu.

nodes.label: Resend Bill — Status View
nodes.desc: Shows Resend Bill status: Sl No, Bill Number, Status, Process Date.

nodes.label: Resend Bill — Template Action Menu
nodes.desc: Action menu per record: edit the Resend Bill Template.

nodes.label: Console Search
nodes.desc: Search by Document type, Status, Language, MSISDN, Account No, Email, Bill Number, Customer Type.

nodes.label: Storage & Retention Policy
nodes.desc: Retains successful/failed XMLs, documents and emails for the configured period; auto-cleanup after expiry.

nodes.label: Multi-Language Support
nodes.desc: Supports additional languages beyond English and Arabic.

nodes.label: Tax Field Support
nodes.desc: Tax-related information is received as part of invoice data and displayed on the generated invoice.

nodes.label: Interactive PDF Tabs
nodes.desc: Bill sections move to PDF tabs for one-click navigation.

nodes.label: Interactive PDF Dynamic Links
nodes.desc: Interactive PDF supports graphical information and dynamic links.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Support
nodes.desc: Supports invoice generation in currencies other than Qatari Riyal, per source XML.

nodes.label: Old Invoice Compatibility
nodes.desc: Produces historical invoices from legacy data across all time periods.

nodes.label: CSV Not Received Report
nodes.desc: Scheduler checks every 10 minutes; alerts if a supporting CSV is still missing 4 hours after XML receipt.

nodes.label: Failed Email Report
nodes.desc: Lists email addresses for which the bill email could not be sent.

nodes.label: Failed Bill Report
nodes.desc: Lists bills/documents that failed processing with status and reason.

nodes.label: Log Email Delivery to CRM
nodes.desc: Creates a CRM notification record after an invoice email is sent, for servicing and audit.

nodes.label: Bill Template Redesign
nodes.desc: Supports changing/removing field positions per role and per customer segment/invoice type, maintained via configuration.
